title: Majorizing Measures for Canonical Processes with Log-Concave Tails
summary: Let $Y_1,\ldots,Y_n$ be independent symmetric random variables with log-concave tails. We give a dimension-free characterization of the expected supremum of the canonical process $X_x=\sum_{i=1}^n x_iY_i$ without any $Δ_2$ or regular-growth assumption on the coordinate tails. The characterization is governed by scale-dependent intrinsic costs determined directly by the convex tail potentials. It has an information-theoretic rate-distortion formulation as well as two equivalent majorizing-measure formulations on the original index set, one multiscale and one based on a single probability…
